ei.title: Chapter 5-16 2번: Identity Consistency vs. Positive Feelings
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: The discovery that identities change the way we seek information raises interesting questions. For example, there is ample evidence that people try to make themselves look good in many situations. In contrast, researchers also found that people seek out negative information about themselves if it supports a negative identity. How is it that a person wants to make herself look good, while at the same time she wants to make herself look bad? Some researchers proposed that people try to obtain information that is consistent with their identities, whether they think of themselves positively or negatively. That is, people seek information that seems to them to be true, even if that information is negative about themselves. In contrast, positive information makes people feel good, whether it is consistent with their identity or not. Emotionally, people want to look as good as possible.

questions.passage: The discovery that identities change the way we seek information raises interesting questions. For example, there is ample evidence that people try to make themselves look good in many situations. In contrast, researchers also found that people seek out negative information about themselves if it supports a negative identity. How is it that a person wants to make herself look good, while at the same time she wants to make herself look bad? Some researchers proposed that people try to obtain information that is consistent with their identities, whether they think of themselves positively or negatively. That is, people seek information that seems to them to be true, even if that information is negative about themselves. In contrast, positive information makes people feel good, whether it is consistent with their identity or not. Emotionally, people want to look as good as possible.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정체성 일치 정보를 찾되 긍정적 정보는 일치 여부와 무관하게 수용한다는 것이 요지.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 정체성 일치 정보 + 긍정적 정보는 일치 무관 수용 ←정답
❌ ② 부정적 정보만 선호 — 반대
❌ ③ 정체성 무관 — 반대
❌ ④ 감정 무관 — 본문은 감정적으로 좋게 보이려 함

ch: 사람들은 정체성과 일치하는 정보를 찾되, 긍정적 정보는 일치 여부와 무관하게 기분 좋게 받아들인다.
정체성은 정보 탐색과 아무런 관련이 없다.
감정은 정보의 진위 판단에 영향을 주지 않는다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]을 이용하여 빈칸을 완성하시오.

"사람들은 (많은 상황에서) 자신을 좋게 보이게 하려고 애쓴다"의 일부:
people __________ in many situations.

[조건] (1) good, look, make, themselves, to, try 를 모두 사용
       (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)
